name: v8_fertilizer
description: The fertilizer loop, at the right dose. Environment rules line 64: a watered day adds +1 unit, or +2 if the tile is fertilized -- fertilizing doubles yield, and fertilizer comes free from livestock. Dose matters more than direction: fert_weight 5.0 with collect 2.0 measured 2W-18L against v4 because fertilising crowded out harvesting, while 3.5/1.0 measured 31W-19L. Earlier animals alone measured 40% -- neutral. The gain is the fertilizer loop, not the livestock.
